title: Email Campaign Manager
subtitle: It builds each campaign from a template for a chosen list or segment, sends a test, schedules or sends it, and files it in the right folder.
lede: It builds each campaign from a template for a chosen list or segment, sends a test, schedules or sends it, and files it in the right folder. Afterwards it sends the report and exports who opened, clicked or bounced.
author: Corey James
